The analysis takes into account the game intensity of the participating teams, placing Mexican soccer in the top 10 competitions with the slowest pace according to the methodology used by the organization.
La Liga MX ranks seventh among national competitions with the lowest game intensity, according to a study by the CIES Football Observatory.
The figure places Mexican soccer behind leagues such as those of the United Arab Emirates, Ecuador, Peru, China, Colombia, and Saudi Arabia.
